newsitem.title: USA: USDA releases $275 Mln GSM-102 credits to Mexico.
newsitem.headline: USDA releases $275 Mln GSM-102 credits to Mexico.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department said Wednesday it released an additional $275 million in short-term export credit guarantees to Mexico.
The allocation brought the GSM-102 export credit total for Mexico to $1.075 billion, the amount allocated for fiscal 1997, which ends September 30.
No change was made in the commodities eligible for credits nor were terms of coverage altered.
Export credits facilitate sale of U.S. ag exports by assuring lenders they will be repaid.
